name: Green test and rainbow noise (sonar)
plain: FFT filter on the fourth root of frequency, then a separate std scaling. Rainbow is two summed green draws with weights.
math:
f=fy²+fx²; P=√f; P(0,0)=base; n=ifft2(fft2(ε)/√P); n←n·(scale_fac/(w·h))/std(n); real part. then normalized.
rainbow_mild: 1.15·(0.55·g₁+0.7·g₂); intense: 1.15·(.75·g₁+.5·g₂).
